title: Here are my predictions for Monday (01/05/26)
summary: There will be a post asking if MU can go higher.There will be a post mentioning that the valuations are ridiculously high and that we are, in fact, in a bubble of epic bubbly proportions.There will be a post where the user is going to be quite confused and distraught.
